evidence.observation: Owner/admin metadata audit found two current branch heads, no tags, no releases, no pull requests, 71 unexpired Actions artifacts, and a former main commit still returning HTTP 200; no artifact archive or retired sample content was downloaded.

All 57 retired-lineage artifact deletions returned HTTP 204. The post-delete inventory contains only the 14 preserved sanitized-lineage artifacts, with zero targets remaining, zero preserved artifacts missing, and the sanitized-root artifact still present.

The former main commit and its fork-network path still return HTTP 200. A cleanup request was prepared but not transmitted because GitHub Support requires interactive GitHub sign-in and no authenticated in-app or connected Chrome session was available.
The migration record and docs map now distinguish completed Actions cleanup from the remaining GitHub Support and external-copy boundary and point to the reusable D-drive evidence.

GitHub Support ticket #4633618, Clear Cached Views, is Open and was created through the Virtual Agent for the repository and dangling commit. No repository deletion was requested and no private content was uploaded. Immediately after submission, the former commit still returned HTTP 200 from both the parent repository and fork network.
